data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for interactive, themable Gantt charts with drag‑drop and real‑time sync.
data.what_it_does: It renders large Gantt timelines using CustomPainter and lets users create, move, resize, and link tasks. Data can be loaded dynamically and updated in real time via a controller.
use_when: You need a timeline view for project scheduling or resource planning in a Flutter app
You require interactive task manipulation (drag‑drop, resize) and custom theming
You want offline‑first support with CRDT‑based sync
avoid_when: You only need simple line/bar/pie charts (overkill for Gantt)
Your app targets very low‑end devices where custom painting of thousands of tasks may be heavy
strengths: Rich interactivity: drag‑drop, resizing, dependency creation
Extensive theming and custom widget builders
weaknesses: Large dependency footprint (provider, intl, many server libs)
Requires Dart 3.13 and Flutter 3.47+ (may limit older projects)
Not a general‑purpose chart library; focused solely on Gantt
data.setup_notes: Add the package and its peer dependencies (provider, intl, material_ui). Ensure your app uses Dart 3.13 and Flutter 3.47+. No code‑gen required.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a wide range of chart types including Gantt, with a mature UI kit and commercial support
